title: VietHerb-MTL: split-dependent transfer benchmark and locked plant-bag extension
description: Reproducible code, frozen configurations, audits, predictions, and evidence for a ChEMBL 37 multi-target activity benchmark, together with a prospectively locked multiple-instance learning protocol for plant-level auxiliary supervision.
